highlights: The AI landscape is experiencing rapid advancements in real-time, multimodal interaction, with new full-duplex LLMs from ByteDance and NVIDIA enabling more natural and interactive human-AI communication.

The AI agent ecosystem is maturing significantly, marked by the release of open-source frameworks for agent development lifecycle management, automated design, and robust memory solutions, empowering builders to create more reliable and sophisticated agents.

Major players like OpenAI and Google are not only enhancing their flagship models with improved performance and expanded access but also rolling out robust developer tools and platforms, streamlining the creation and deployment of production-ready AI solutions.

agents.title: Meet Shepherd: An Open-Source Python Substrate for Agent Development
agents.summary: Shepherd is an MIT-licensed Python runtime that records agent-environment interactions as Git-like execution traces, allowing meta-agents to fork, replay, and revert runs, accelerating agent development and debugging by up to 5x.

agents.title: ADIAS: Automated Design Framework for Interactive Agentic Systems
agents.summary: ADIAS is a new framework that streamlines agent design through issue-centric optimization, maintaining persistent issue states to guide focused full-code modifications, outperforming baselines by 25.2% on interactive benchmarks.

agents.title: Shape Your Feed (SYF): LLM-based Agentic System for Conversational Recommendation
agents.summary: SYF is a three-tier LLM-based agentic framework that enables real-time, multimodal co-curation of content in industrial recommendation systems, allowing users to explicitly steer their feeds and improving relevance.

models.title: ByteDance SeedRealtime: Native Audio-Visual Full-Duplex LLM for Omni-Modal Interaction
models.summary: SeedRealtime by ByteDance fuses audio, video, and text in a single architecture, enabling real-time, continuous multimodal interaction, a significant step towards truly omni-modal AI.

models.title: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer: Local, Agentic, Multimodal, Open-Source Model
models.summary: Meta's Muse Glimmer is a new open-source, agentic, and multimodal model designed for local deployment, empowering developers to build highly capable and private AI applications.

models.title: Mistral AI Releases Shieldstral 1.0 3B: Open-Weights Policy-Adaptive Multimodal Safety Classifier
models.summary: Mistral AI's Shieldstral 1.0 3B is an open-weights, multimodal safety classifier that allows operators to define content moderation policies via plain-language queries at inference time, matching larger models in performance.

tools.title: Tencent Cloud Open-Sources TencentDB Agent Memory v2.0 for AI Coding Agents
tools.summary: TencentDB Agent Memory v2.0 is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted memory hub for AI coding agents, organizing conversations, documents, and code into governed assets with ACL-based visibility and version control.

tools.title: Comprehensive Comparison of Top LLM Observability and Evaluation Platforms in 2026
tools.summary: A detailed comparison of leading LLM observability and evaluation platforms, including Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, and Arize, provides builders with critical insights into tracing, evaluation, monitoring, and pricing for production-grade LLMs.

tools.title: Google Expands Gemini API Managed Agents with 3.6 Flash and Hooks
tools.summary: Google's Gemini API Managed Agents now offer new capabilities, including 3.6 Flash and hooks, empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents for diverse applications.

companies.title: OpenAI Improves GPT-5.6 Sol and Expands GPT-5.6 Luna Access for Free Users
companies.summary: OpenAI has enhanced GPT-5.6 Sol with better accuracy and consistency within ChatGPT, while also expanding access to the advanced GPT-5.6 Luna model for all free users, increasing accessibility to powerful AI.

companies.title: OpenAI Details Engineering Behind Real-Time, Responsive Voice AI (GPT-Live)
companies.summary: OpenAI shares insights into the development of GPT-Live, a real-time system for continuous voice interaction, showcasing a turnless speech model and low-latency architecture that enables faster and more natural AI conversations.

companies.title: Meta Launches Muse Glimmer: Local, Agentic, Multimodal, Open-Source Model
companies.summary: Meta's release of Muse Glimmer signifies a strong push into open-source, locally deployable, agentic, and multimodal AI, empowering developers and researchers with advanced capabilities outside of proprietary ecosystems.

learning.title: Kaggle’s AI Agents Intensive: A Massive Free Coding Course by Google
learning.summary: Google and Kaggle successfully launched a no-cost 'AI Agents Intensive' coding course, attracting 353,000 learners to build and deploy AI agents, significantly advancing global AI upskilling.

learning.title: Tutorial: Building Multimodal RAG Pipeline with NVIDIA NeMo Retriever
learning.summary: This tutorial provides a comprehensive guide to constructing an advanced multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline, leveraging NVIDIA NeMo Retriever, hosted NIMs, and LanceDB for robust AI applications.

learning.title: Tutorial: Robust Sentiment Analysis with DistilBERT LoRA and Semi-Supervised Learning
learning.summary: This comprehensive tutorial guides users through building a robust sentiment analysis workflow, combining classical TF-IDF with modern parameter-efficient fine-tuning (DistilBERT + LoRA) for scalable and interpretable sentiment inference.
